scope: Classic DFG declared metadata, internal IDs, occurrence lookup gates and boundary list/map forms, plus EventLog metadata preservation.
probe_cmake:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(heuristic_dfg_input_probe LANGUAGES CXX)
option(HAS_DFG_METADATA "Use list boundary input API" OFF)
add_executable(heuristic_dfg_input_probe main.cpp)
target_compile_features(heuristic_dfg_input_probe PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(heuristic_dfg_input_probe PRIVATE ../petri-comparison-checkpoint-source/include)
target_link_libraries(heuristic_dfg_input_probe PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../petri-comparison-checkpoint-build/Release/minera_core.lib" bcrypt winsqlite3 ws2_32)
if(HAS_DFG_METADATA)
 target_compile_definitions(heuristic_dfg_input_probe PRIVATE HAS_DFG_METADATA)
endif()
limits: Finite integer-frequency/string-label Classic DFG inputs and selected EventLog metadata projections.
Reference rejections compare acceptance versus rejection; Python exception-class/message identity is not claimed.
Native frequency DFG input is an ordered map; arbitrary Python dictionary insertion-order transport is outside this input surface.
No full object, adapter or structural coverage completion is claimed.
